contexts.text: This truth... emanated from the Ancient Church.
Spheres continually emane, nay pour forth, from every Society. 103 12[end].
This custom emanated to many outside the Church...
Thence emanated such things as were of Divine worship to the surrounding nations.
They said that this faith had emanated chiefly from the learned.
From these, religious things emanated into the Indies...
From the body, substances continually emanate in a stream, and the things which emanate surround him.
May be compared to the waters emanating from an impure fountain...
All the heresies which have emanated therefrom...
Thence has emanated falsity into the whole Christian world.
The spheres which emane from Spirits and Angels...
He takes the greatest care lest anything of the insane concupiscence in which his spirit is should become known.
Thence a sort of frenzy has spread itself into the whole of theology.
That Sun is the circle which proximately surrounds the Lord, emanating from His Divine love and at the same time from His Divine wisdom.
This cold emanated from the fatuous light of their faith.
From every man there emanes a spiritual sphere... it emanes both through the face and through the breathing.
A stream of fire issuing and going forth from before Him () = the Divine good of love and thence the Divine truth.
From Him as a Sun there have emaned in like manner auras and atmospheres...
Like a fountain of bitumen or black water, from which nothing emanates but what is impure. That which emanates from it... is not good...
Their riches then spread themselves to the public use...
